title: Listening Section 1 - Animal Shelter Volunteer Registration
instruction: You will hear a woman registering as a volunteer at an animal shelter. Answer Questions 1-10.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Hello, Oakfield Animal Shelter, Daniel speaking.

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: Hello. I'd like to register as a volunteer, please.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Wonderful, thank you. I'll just fill in the form while we talk. What's your surname?

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Thanks. Can I ask why you'd like to volunteer?

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: I retired last month, and I've always loved animals. I'd like to do something useful with my free time.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: That's a good reason. Which days are you available?

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: Tuesdays and Saturdays are best for me.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Great. We ask volunteers to give at least one half-day a week, and most people do a Tuesday or a Saturday morning. Have you worked with animals before?

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: Not professionally, but I kept rabbits for many years, and I have also looked after neighbours' dogs.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Rabbits, good. We have quite a few here at the moment. What kind of jobs will you do? Everyone starts by cleaning the kennels and the cages. Some people hope to walk the dogs straight away, but that only comes after the first month.

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: That's fine. I don't mind hard work.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Excellent. The next training session is on the twelfth of June. It starts at ten and lasts two hours. You should wear sturdy boots, because the yard can be muddy.

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: Boots. Okay. Do I need to bring anything else?

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: No, we provide gloves and an apron. After the training, we'll send you the weekly rota by email, so please check your inbox regularly. We used to put it on the noticeboard, but too many people missed it.

transcript.speaker: Imogen
transcript.text: I'll do that. Thank you very much, Daniel.

transcript.speaker: Daniel
transcript.text: Thank you for volunteering. We look forward to meeting you.
